_comment: Word list used by moderation.service.js to flag outgoing agent messages — no AI/API involved, so this list is the ONLY thing controlling what gets caught. Edit freely: add/remove words, redeploy, done. 'severe' = clear profanity/insults/threats. 'minor' = rude/dismissive but not outright abusive. Matching is done against the message with all spaces/punctuation stripped and lowercased, so entries here should also be written with no spaces.
